instruction: Shake the medium-sized plastic bottle with capped top after picking it with the right arm.

source.instruction: Shake the medium-sized plastic bottle with capped top after picking it with the right arm.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the bottle, which was at x = +14 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.plan: Lower right arm slightly, orient gripper to match bottle angle, and move closer toward the bottle.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +14, -4) cm, now 16 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.plan: Lift bottle slightly off the table to begin shaking.
